title: Resolve a service primary group
task: Use captures/passwd.txt to find the UID and primary GID of appsvc. Save the UID in uid.txt and its primary group name from captures/group.txt in group.txt. One value and newline per report. Preserve both captures.
hints: Inspect both capture files. The passwd fields are name:password:UID:GID:description:home:shell; group records use name:password:GID:members.

gid=$(awk -F: '$1 == "appsvc" {print $4}' captures/passwd.txt)
awk -F: -v gid="$gid" '$3 == gid {print $1}' captures/group.txt > group.txt
Then run cli-silly check.

checks.label: The UID belongs to appsvc in the captured passwd file
checks.feedback: Select the appsvc record in captures/passwd.txt and output its third colon-delimited field.

checks.label: The group name matches the primary GID, not supplementary membership
checks.feedback: Read field 4 from the appsvc passwd record, then match that number to field 3 in captures/group.txt.

demo.explanation: builder has UID 1200 and primary GID 2300. The operators member list records a separate supplementary membership.
-F: selects colon-separated fields. The condition selects builder, print $4 emits its primary GID, and $(...) captures the output.
-v passes the shell value into awk. Match numeric GID field 3 and print group-name field 1. No host users are modified.
